reviews.text: THANKS !

This was the first grooming session for our 7-month-old poodle, who had grown into a little woolly mammoth, and we are delighted. A superb scissor cut that preserved her cuddly appearance while allowing her to face the summer with ease. The explanations about the cut were very clear and perfectly accurate. A big thank you to the very friendly team. We'll be back!

Fantastic salon. We don't live in Paris full-time, but we only book appointments at this salon for our little dachshund, Neia. Thanks again to the team for their efficiency and kindness towards animals. Truly excellent.
An amazing place where my little long-haired dachshund left happy, even with a little gift from the lovely owner, Marie. I highly recommend this place 🐶❤️ …
Lovely shop. Very welcoming and professional.

My dog ​​just before going there… and after…
Shaved without my consent for €90!!
She was supposed to come out looking beautiful, and now,
she looks like a rat!

I entrusted my dog ​​to the salon for grooming and a haircut, but I'm very disappointed with the result. The haircut was really poorly done. It looks like the person who did it lacked experience, or was even a beginner.
Before, everything went very well at this salon, but this time the work was done carelessly and sloppily. You really have to pay attention, because the grooming is very poorly done.
I don't think I'll be back unless the quality improves.
This salon unfortunately did not respond to my request for grooming availability. The request was made on February 25th, and I have received no response as of today, March 13th.

Our usual groomer for our maltipoo, and the work is always impeccable and our instructions are followed. They are very punctual and never overwhelmed, which is nice compared to other places we've been.

Absolutely perfect! We've been taking Maggie, our little Pomeranian, there for over 5 years, and she's always impeccable.
They know the breed perfectly and respect the unique nature of the Pomeranian coat.

Plus, the team is truly lovely, always a kind word, checking in on us, and always offering advice.

The shop is beautiful and has lots of lovely things.

I wouldn't go anywhere else!

They should have a loyalty card :-)

Camille, Victor, Maggie (and soon Andy)

I went to so many groomers before finding a good one! Then, one after another, they told me they no longer took large dogs! I finally found the perfect place... they take care of our dogs with so much love and kindness 🫶🏼.

Thank you to the whole team and especially the owner!! A true professional! And we get our dog back perfectly clean and brushed, and we're all set for a while!!

Our dog: Akita Inu ♥️
Gorgeous

A very nice, well-stocked shop with lots of new items and an unparalleled selection of harnesses of all types and sizes – definitely worth a visit!
My little bulldog Paddy's grooming was impeccable!
The manager and her team are very welcoming, helpful, and highly professional.

Friendly welcome, lovely and competent staff. The only slight drawback is the small size of the shop.
Very convenient in this neighborhood where grooming salons are few and far between. And Raoul leaves looking like a dandy...

Marie's team has been taking wonderful care of Maki for years. The best proof is that he comes home completely confident, dreams of all the toys, and leaves even more handsome than before! Go for it without hesitation!
Thank you to the four-legged grooming counter, always so satisfied with my dachshund's grooming 😃 …

Updated response:

“Took the trouble to speak with me?” — that’s the bare minimum of customer service.

As mentioned during my visit, I called the same day I noticed the damaged leash but received no response.

Your reply again shows no accountability or genuine apology, which only confirms my experience. I understand my dog’s breed can be challenging to groom — which is why I gave multiple chances before sharing an honest review.

Raising your voice, refusing to speak with me directly, and passing the issue back to the groomer — the person the complaint was about — says everything. This response only reinforces why I won’t be returning. Ciao.

______________________
Be prepared to overpay for a mediocre cut that doesn’t match the request or look uniform. It feels like too many dogs are booked at once, which means less attention to detail and a less positive experience overall.

Additionally, no accountability (nor mention) of the brand new leash being destroyed while at the shop.
A wonderful team dedicated to the well-being of our four-legged friends. I am very satisfied with their work. And my little Shih Tzu always looks gorgeous after their excellent care.

We've been coming every four months or so for the past four years for our (very hairy and fluffy) Spitz.

He always comes out beautifully groomed, completely detangled, clean, and so soft!
The grooming is done with care for the Spitz's unique coat!
Clean and pleasant place. They take very good care of the dogs. 🐶 I'm a loyal customer. Just a little more smile and friendliness would be perfect. …

Fantastic! Fair price, beautiful salon, and a super friendly owner.
I highly recommend it!
Excellent grooming service, I'm very pleased! I highly recommend it!!

A fantastic welcome! Marie was very attentive to the well-being of my Staffordshire Bull Terrier, who is very timid and hates water!

I highly recommend her!
Thank you again for all the valuable advice!

I took my cocker spaniel in for a grooming appointment, and the result was disastrous. Instead of respecting my request, my dog ​​was shaved on his head, had his back cut with scissors, and was also shaved on the front of his legs. As a result, his fur can no longer be properly trimmed in those areas. For a botched haircut, I paid €150, which is completely excessive. On top of that, I had to go back so they could try to fix their mistake. A disappointing and frustrating experience; I absolutely do not recommend this groomer.

Success! An adult male Labrador who's afraid of heights and the dryer... during his transition from puppy to adult coat, and on top of that, winter to summer... and I'm so glad I met a team who took the time to care for him, even though the bathtub was full of fur, even though we had to use the dryer on the floor because he refused to get on the table! Thank you for him, and bad news!!! He'll have to come back after the summer 😂😂😂

I discovered this salon a few years ago and I don't regret my choice at all. My Yorkshire Terrier is always immaculate. The welcome is very pleasant and the staff are very kind and attentive.
I highly recommend it!

A huge thank you to the whole team! My dog, who can usually be quite reactive, is always treated wonderfully here, with gentleness, patience, and professionalism. Every time, I receive tons of compliments on his haircut and overall look. It's truly reassuring to know he's in such good hands. I recommend them 100%!
Excellent performance.
My Coton de Tulear looks magnificent after its scissor cut! Friendly welcome and a very nice shop with lots of different treats and accessories! I'll gladly return! :)
The service exceeded my expectations. The staff was welcoming, professional, and kind to the animals. I highly recommend them; I'm thrilled! Thank you so much! 🙏 …

The last time I picked up my dog, I heard a dog whining as I walked in. I asked if it was mine, and they replied, "Maybe." That was the last straw after increasingly worse grooming experiences. Frankly unacceptable.

Avoid at all costs.
I picked up my dog ​​with a raw wound on her ear, the flesh exposed. When I picked her up, I was simply told she had "redness." It was only upon my return that I discovered the extent of the damage.

I am fully aware that accidents can happen, especially if the animal is moving. But in this case, the least you could do is honestly inform the customer and apologize face-to-face, not during the phone call I made to express my dissatisfaction.

It's well known that Pomeranians often get knots behind their ears, and I understand the use of clippers. But you should never injure an animal to remove a knot. It's unacceptable and irresponsible to return a dog in this condition without even warning or explaining.

Another point: an initial estimate of €95, and a final bill of €110 upon pickup, with an additional charge for care that I didn't request. In addition to returning my injured dog to me, they charged me for treatment without my consent. A quote, by definition, cannot be changed without the client's agreement.

If their approach had been humane, honest, and respectful, I would have been the first to understand. But this is a lack of professionalism.
Absolutely perfect!!
Delighted with the service. I highly recommend it!

Best grooming salon in Paris!

I recommend it 100%! The staff is quick, efficient, and attentive to the animals' well-being!
Marie always gives great advice and is passionate about her work…
Absolutely stunning work. Very pleased! 😍 …
They took very good care of my dog, Hugo.

The service met all my expectations; my poodle is looking beautiful and clean to start the new year! It was our first experience at this salon, and we'll definitely be back! Furthermore, the welcome was warm, and all the staff were lovely; a haven of happiness for our dog! I highly recommend it!
Super!

Good evening, madam. Why give us one star? We spoke with you for 15 minutes before taking your dog, explaining the consequences of the clipping. There was no other solution. Your dog was clipped with a #10 blade—the shortest blade—because her fur was matted from head to paws. We really shouldn't have agreed to take her. You would have ended up at the vet's with a hygiene razor!

A very disappointing experience. The grooming service did not meet our expectations at all. The instructions we gave were not followed: our dachshund's ears were cropped too high compared to what we had requested (we only asked for the undersides to be trimmed, not the tops), and her belly was shaved without our consent. Her haircut is uneven, with visible irregularities and a "stepped" effect all over her body. This is not the work of a professional, and it pains us to see her in this state.

We also found the reception to be impersonal, and the overall experience felt like a rushed, assembly-line job, without the attention or care we expected for our pet. We are very disappointed and feel that the service does not justify the exorbitant price charged. It didn't even deserve a price, considering the state of the dog, which we'll have to try and fix as best we can in a few months. €90?! Outrageous, to say the least. How is it possible to return our dog to us in this condition? Do you even look at your employees' work, or is it just the bottom line that matters? If I were you, I'd be ashamed.

One last thing: you should let owners know when their dog's grooming is finished. This would prevent our pet from being locked up somewhere upstairs. A very bad experience.

Very high increase
even though the work remains meticulous!

Perfect grooming for my cocker spaniel and very friendly staff!
He comes back every time with pleasure, which is a good sign that they take care of him gently and attentively!
Super friendly! Very professional and full of good advice for the haircut ✌️Thank you!
Great groomer, happy with the result ✅🐶 …
